title: Karpathy 用 Claude 周末复刻出 HN 精选视频平台
summary: Karpathy 用 Claude 一个周末做出「AI 精选版 Hacker News」，另有社区把 284B DeepSeek-V4-Flash 压进 64GB 纯 CPU 跑起来——窗口偏安静，但这两个都在刷屏。
summary_en: A quiet news window overall, with two high-signal items. Andrej Karpathy reportedly built a curated, AI-generated Hacker News-style video platform in a single weekend using Claude, drawing on two decades of HN archives; the project drew wide attention on Hacker News and highlights how far agentic coding has advanced for solo developers. Separately, the open-source project llama-modchip gained traction by running a 284B DeepSeek-V4-Flash mixture-of-experts model, along with 30B MoE variants, on pure CPU with no GPU, fitting under 59 GiB of RAM at 256K context and reaching roughly 44 tokens per second prefill.
body:
Karpathy 用 Claude 一个周末做出「AI 精选版 Hacker News」，另有社区把 284B DeepSeek-V4-Flash 压进 64GB 纯 CPU 跑起来——窗口偏安静，但这两个都在刷屏。

Anthropic
- Karpathy 用 Claude 一个周末做出 AI 精选版 Hacker News 视频站 — 2026-11-08 22:23（北京时间）发布、HN 上讨论升温，说明 Claude 的 agentic 编码能力已能支撑个人周末级产品。
  https://the-decoder.com/andrej-karpathy-built-a-curated-video-platform-in-a-weekend-using-claude-and-20-years-of-hacker-news

DeepSeek
- 开源项目 llama-modchip 让 284B DeepSeek-V4-Flash 在纯 CPU 64GB 上跑起来 — 零 GPU、峰值内存约 59GiB、256K 上下文，把 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 的本地部署门槛压到个人机器级别。
  https://github.com/synchopate/llama-modchip

Source: https://the-decoder.com/andrej-karpathy-built-a-curated-video-platform-in-a-weekend-using-claude-and-20-years-of-hacker-news
